services.name: Wheel Rental
services.desc: We have 7 VL WHISPER Pottery Wheels available to be used in your home studio for a monthly rental fee. $60 per month for Wheel rental, $40 firing fee - one firing cycle per month (bisque and glaze considered one cycle) to be charged at time of greenware pottery drop off Wheel rental is due on the first of each month: Includes one wheel per person, splash pan, one set of bat pins, one bat, which should be spray painted with CCC in orange, late fee of $25 after 10th of the month Only the Wheels deemed for Rental are available, and are not to be substituted or traded out for another Studio Wheel. Wheels may not be moved to or stored at any location other than the address listed above. Rented
